name: T02_hero_six_levels
final_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Generate one polished promotional key-art image. Aspect ratio: 3:2 landscape. Keep important subjects within middle 80% of height for landscape or middle 80% of width for portrait.
All attached images are visual references, not edit targets. Preserve character and environment designs; ignore reference UI and lettering.
SCENE:
Six tall vertical slices side by side with thin black gaps, slightly slanted, one per level in order, each showing that level's place and, where it has one, its entity: 1 yellow office corridor with the black hunched Entity and its amber eyes; 2 the cream stepwell and green pool, empty; 3 the party room with road-map carpet and the balloon-headed Mall Manager; 4 the neon cinema corridor with the crimson Usher; 5 a single-colour void room with a player jumping between ledges; 6 the soft-play arena court with the doll Counter at the red post. Follow the two boards exactly for looks. The upper third of every slice is darker.
Leave the UPPER-LEFT third calm and darker for the game title. No lettering.

COMMON ART DIRECTION AND CONSTRAINTS:
## NO LETTERING
No title, no caption, no logo, no watermark, no HUD, no UI, no key hints, no numbers. Claude adds the title and
the "LEVEL n" lines later in a fixed typeface, so each image says where to leave calm, darker, uncluttered
space for them. The only letters allowed are signs that exist in the game and are named in the image's text
(PLAY ZONE, EXIT, ZYNTRA RELAY). Regenerate if any other lettering appears or a named sign is misspelled.

## What the pictures are for
Store gallery, the main thumbnail and a paid ad campaign for a Roblox co-op horror game. What worked last time
and what the owner asked for then still holds: highly clickable, one clear idea per image that reads at
320 x 180, ACCURATE to each level. The research on the genre's biggest games said: lead with teammates hiding
while the thing passes, and show that the levels are six recognisably different places.

The owner has rejected generated art as "AI slop" before. So: be faithful, not generic. Rebuild the real
places in the references with better light, lens and detail. Never invent a new monster, a new room type, new
props, gore, blood, weapons or jump-scare faces. If a reference shows it plain, keep it plain.

## The player (every human in every image)
See `refs/player_suit_front.jpg`, `refs/player_suit_back.jpg` (or `refs/board_player.jpg`). A stylised, chunky
game avatar, about three heads tall: mustard-yellow hooded hazmat suit of crumpled fabric, the hood up; a black
gas mask with TWO ROUND LENSES and one round filter in front; black backpack straps, a black belt with pouches,
a black tactical backpack with two small olive tanks at its sides; black mitten-like gloves; chunky black boots.
Never a realistic human, never a bare face, never a clear visor, never a different colour of suit. All players
look the same. They may carry a small hand torch.

## The six levels (the references are the truth; this is what you are looking at)
1. LEVEL 1, THE OFFICE. The classic yellow backrooms: mustard damask wallpaper, beige-brown carpet, low white
   acoustic-tile ceiling with fluorescent panels, square pillars, endless low partitions, black marker scribbles
   on walls. ENTITY, "the Entity": a tall, hunched, pitch-black figure in a rough hooded knit garment, heavy
   shoulders, very long arms, big long-fingered hands, chunky feet, two small round glowing eyes (amber when
   calm, red when hunting). It hears noise. Players pull fuses out of wall cabinets marked ZYNTRA RELAY, carry
   them to fuse boxes, pull levers and run for the exit.
2. LEVEL 2, THE POOLROOMS. BRAND NEW MAP. THERE IS NO ENTITY, NO MONSTER, NO CREATURE AND NO FOAM IN LEVEL 2.
   It is a silent, sunlit, clean, endless bath-house you walk through: a flooded hall of tiled columns and
   vaults over turquoise water; a nave of colossal fluted concrete columns; an immense stepwell of zig-zag
   stairs with glass rails down to a green pool; a domed rotunda in deep blue and gold mosaic with a golden
   gong on an island; a lap-pool hall with ribbon windows onto empty desert; and a ten-storey atrium of
   identical yellow doors over a drained pool. Cream plaster, pale tile, warm daylight. Awe and loneliness.
3. LEVEL 3, THE PARTY ROOMS. A dead mall's children's party rooms: road-map play carpet or dark confetti
   carpet, cream or orange walls with a black lower band, black tile ceiling with a few panels, folding tables
   with paper cups and plates, plastic kids' chairs, balloons, wall stickers. Players collect five CDs in jewel
   cases and hide UNDER the folding tables. ENTITY, "the Mall Manager": very tall and thin; its head is a
   glossy RED BALLOON with no face; short-sleeved shirt with wide orange and cream vertical stripes and a white
   name tag; black trousers, white belt buckle, black shoes; long thin pale arms ending in RED GLOVES. The
   reference shows it in a stiff arms-out rig pose: never draw that pose. Draw it walking, stooping, peering.
4. LEVEL 4, THE CINEMA. An 80s-90s multiplex lost in the backrooms: navy walls, magenta and cyan neon bands, a
   carpet of pink and blue triangles on a dotted grid, a starlight ceiling, arcade cabinets, red seats, a
   glowing screen, a projector booth. With the power off it is black with deep red emergency light. ENTITY,
   "the Usher": very tall and thin, in a crimson bellhop uniform with gold buttons in two rows, gold cuffs and a
   gold stripe down the trouser leg, a crimson pillbox cap with a gold band; its head is a glossy BLACK
   featureless mannequin head with no face; its hands are bright WHITE gloves that glow. It only exists in the
   dark and freezes while a torch beam is on it. Same note: the reference is a stiff rig pose, do not copy the
   pose.
5. LEVEL 5, THE VOID. THERE IS NO ENTITY IN LEVEL 5. Ten huge rooms, each ONE colour (rose, blue, amber, mint,
   violet, coral, orange, crimson, teal, ivory), smooth matte plastic, soft pools of light near the top, and
   below the walkways nothing but black. Players jump along narrow ledges, block tops, pillar tops and spiral
   stairs with treads missing. A fall is death. Dark blue balls lie on some ledges; a small lamp globe hangs on
   a long thin rod here and there.
6. LEVEL 6, THE PLAYGROUND. One colossal indoor soft-play arena: a round court of blue-and-green foam puzzle
   mats with a yellow ring and a short RED padded post in the middle, and all round it twelve storeys of
   netted galleries: posts wrapped in yellow, red, blue and green vinyl, black knotted nets, mat decks, red
   panels with round bubble windows, big tube slides, rope bridges high across the court, cold strip lights,
   loose plastic balls. ENTITY, "the Counter": a porcelain ball-jointed doll child about as tall as a player
   and a half: bald white cracked head, large dark glass eyes, rosy cheeks, a small closed smile, a striped
   paper party cone hat, a striped T-shirt in faded orange, blue and cream, dusty denim dungaree shorts, bare
   jointed limbs. It counts at the post with its hands over its eyes while players hide, then comes looking.

## Look
Polished promotional key art of THIS game: the real geometry, colours and materials of the references, with
cinematic practical light, real depth, a little haze and fine film grain. Strong simple composition, a clear
focal point, a readable silhouette against a lighter or darker ground. Players and entity must be fully inside
the frame unless the image says close-up. Never more than one entity in an image unless the image says so.

## Check before you accept an image (regenerate up to twice if it fails)
- Is every player exactly the avatar above (yellow hood, twin-lens black gas mask, black backpack)?
- Is the entity the one from the reference, and only where asked? Level 2 and Level 5: no creature at all.
- Any lettering, logo or UI that was not asked for? Any gore?
- Is the calm space for lettering where the image asked for it?

SCENE OVERRIDES GENERAL LORE: Exactly one player total, only in fifth slice. No players in slices 1,2,3,4,6. Second slice is entirely EMPTY cream zigzag stepwell with green pool, no yellow door atrium. All four entities whole-body with feet visible within middle 80% image height. No foreground cropped characters. Upper third of ALL SIX panels dark, especially first two panels. Blank nametag with no letters.
remaining_issue: The poolrooms architecture is simplified and brighter than the requested dark upper-third treatment.
